[中文](#cn) | [English](#en)

中文

新增
- **桌面端面板**:远程 dsh web 可直接开在 DSH 桌面应用右侧栏的「浏览器」标签里(`ctx.sidebarRight.openTab("browser", …)`);浏览器半是手写的 bundle(`src/client.js`,`window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 格式),**不需要构建步骤** —— npm、GitHub、本地目录三种安装方式拿到的是同一个文件
- **两种打开方式**:「在侧栏打开」与「在浏览器打开」(宿主直接调用与 CLI 相同的打开器);`openIn`(ask | browser | panel)决定默认值
- **命令卡片**:每条 `/remote …` 命令都会渲染一张卡片,包含命令输出、隧道状态与操作按钮 —— 在侧栏打开 / 在浏览器打开 / 启动隧道(up)/ 断开连接(down,两步确认)/ 刷新。客户端只对第一方命令做本地化,因此命令行与卡片都提供中英文案
- **输入框常驻状态条**(`dock`,默认开启):一行显示隧道状态与同样的操作,不必翻历史找卡片
- **宿主路由** `GET /remote-tunnel/{status,open,up,down}`:每个请求都过 `ctx.connection.admit()`(与 `/api` 通道同一套 Host/Origin 栅栏 + 浏览器会话 cookie 校验),未通过返回 401/403 —— 因为这些路由会下发携带一次性 launch token 的 URL;确实无法携带 cookie 的载体可用 `auth: false` 显式关闭
- **本地化**:`locale/en.json` + `locale/zh.json`(`meta.title` / `meta.description`),插件卡片跟随界面语言(中文界面显示「远程隧道 (dsh-remote-tunnel)」)
- **row 配置**(`home` / `openIn` / `autoOpen` / `dock` / `auth`):可在「设置 → 插件」编辑,默认值在代码里兜底

问题修复
- 模式判定不再依赖邻近行的 `webStartup` 服务,改用 `profileContext.name`(web/desktop):修掉一个启动竞态 —— 判错会让插件走 CLI 分支,`program.help()` → `appExit(0)` **把整个桌面端 / dsh web 宿主进程退掉**
- `Config` schema 不能用 `.default(...)`:在 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 上会让合并后的 row 配置变成未解析的 schema 对象(`{}`),配置值静默丢失;现在只写纯类型,默认值放在 `readSettings()` 里
- peer 范围放宽为 `^0.1.2-alpha.3 || ^0.1.7-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.2`,一个包同时服务两条运行时线

其他变更
- service 模式只创建一个 `TunnelManager`,由 `/remote` 命令与 HTTP 路由共享

已知行为(外壳规则,不是故障)
- 纯新会话里看不到命令卡片:会话视图在没有模型历史时显示欢迎页,命令记录不属于模型历史;发出第一轮对话后,之前的卡片会一起出现(命令早已执行成功)
- 状态条只在"会话已有内容"时渲染:它位于输入框的 dock 座位,而全新会话用的是居中(hero)布局,该座位不渲染 —— 0.2.1 会增加侧栏「远程主机」面板,任何会话状态都能点到

---

English

Added
- **Desktop panel**: the remote dsh web opens inside the DSH desktop app's right sidebar Browser tab (`ctx.sidebarRight.openTab("browser", …)`). The browser half is a hand-written bundle (`src/client.js` in the `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` format) that needs **no build step** — npm, GitHub and local-directory installs ship the same file
- **Two ways to open**: "Open in sidebar" and "Open in browser" (the host runs the same opener the CLI uses); `openIn` (ask | browser | panel) chooses the default
- **Command card**: every `/remote …` command renders a card with its output, the tunnel state and the actions — open in sidebar / open in browser / start tunnel (up) / disconnect (down, two-step confirmation) / refresh. The client localizes only first-party command copy, so both the command row and the card ship bilingual text
- **Composer status strip** (`dock`, on by default): one line of tunnel state with the same actions, so the tunnel is reachable without digging through history
- **Host routes** `GET /remote-tunnel/{status,open,up,down}`: each request passes `ctx.connection.admit()` — the same Host/Origin fence and browser-session cookie the `/api` channel uses — and answers 401/403 otherwise, because these routes hand out a URL carrying a one-time launch token. `auth: false` opts out for a carrier that cannot present a cookie
- **Localization**: `locale/en.json` + `locale/zh.json` (`meta.title` / `meta.description`), so the plugin card follows the UI language
- **Row configuration** (`home` / `openIn` / `autoOpen` / `dock` / `auth`), editable on the Plugins page, defaults resolved in code

Fixed
- Mode detection no longer relies on the neighbouring `webStartup` service but on `profileContext.name` (web/desktop), removing a startup race where a wrong guess took the CLI branch and `program.help()` → `appExit(0)` **terminated the whole desktop/web host process**
- A `Config` schema must not carry `.default(...)`: on dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 that turned the merged row config into unresolved schema objects (`{}`) and silently dropped every configured value; the schema now declares plain types and the defaults live in `readSettings()`
- Peer range widened to `^0.1.2-alpha.3 || ^0.1.7-rc.1 || ^0.2.0-rc.2` so one package serves both runtime lines

Changed
- The service half creates a single `TunnelManager` shared by the `/remote` command and the HTTP routes

Known shell behaviours (not bugs)
- A brand-new conversation shows no command card: the chat view renders the welcome surface until the session has model history, and command lifecycles are deliberately not model history. After the first turn every earlier card appears at once — the commands had already run
- The status strip only renders once a session has content: it lives in the composer's dock seat, which the hero (empty-session) layout does not render. 0.2.1 adds a "Remote hosts" sidebar panel reachable in every session state
